entities.name: Church of the Immaculate Conception of Saint Virgin Mary, Babrujsk
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Church of the Immaculate Conception of Saint Virgin Mary in Babruysk, Belarus, is a Catholic church built in 1901–1903 and rebuilt in 1963. The original facades were vividly decorated in Neo-Gothic style. The church had a high bell tower in the front.
